goal: Allow package transactions trimmed right after entry to be reconsidered instead of blocked until a new block
Avoid unnecessary censorship when fee-bumping an evicted parent transaction with a higher-fee child
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Author narrowed the scope by deferring part of the change per reviewer suggestion (mzumsande)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it fixes misclassification of immediately evicted package transactions
Prevents unneeded rejection of low-feerate packages that can be bumped

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it prevents peer reject filters from blocking evicted parents in 1p1c relay
Restores relay liveness for packages before the next block arrives
